meals.name: Honey-garlic glazed pork loin with blistered green beans and rice
steps: Whisk the glaze: ¼ cup honey, 3 Tbsp soy sauce, 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 Tbsp vinegar, 5 minced garlic cloves and ½ tsp red pepper flakes. Pat a 3 lb pork loin dry and season with 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper.

Sear the loin in 1 Tbsp oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high, 2–3 minutes per side. Brush with half of the remaining glaze and roast at 375°F for 40–50 minutes, brushing once more with the rest, until it reads 145°F in the center. Rest 10 minutes.
Before brushing, set ⅓ of the glaze aside in a small pot. While the pork roasts, cook 1½ cups rice, then simmer the reserved glaze 2 minutes until syrupy.

Blister 1 lb trimmed green beans in 1 Tbsp oil in a hot skillet for 5–6 minutes, then toss with 1 Tbsp butter, 1 minced garlic clove and a splash of soy. Slice the pork and spoon the sticky sauce over pork and rice.

meals.name: Caribbean jerk-style drumsticks with yellow rice and lime
steps: Blend or whisk the jerk marinade: 4 chopped green onions, 4 garlic cloves, juice of 1 lime, 3 Tbsp soy sauce, 2 Tbsp oil, 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp thyme, 1½ tsp allspice, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp pepper, ½–1 tsp cayenne (or 2 Tbsp hot sauce) and 1 tsp salt.
Slash about 4 lb drumsticks to the bone in 2 places, coat with the marinade and refrigerate 1 hour or overnight.
Roast on a foil-lined, oiled sheet pan at 425°F for 35–40 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and 165°F next to the bone (175°F makes them extra tender). Broil 2 minutes for more char.
Cook 2 packages yellow rice as directed. Serve the drumsticks over rice with lime wedges and the remaining green onions sliced on top.

meals.name: Spanish-style sheet-pan chicken thighs with chorizo, potatoes and olives
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Cut 2 lb potatoes into 1-inch chunks and 1 onion into wedges; toss on a sheet pan with 2 Tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Roast 15 minutes.
Toss 2 lb boneless thighs with 1 Tbsp olive oil, 4 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano, ½ tsp cumin, 1 Tbsp vinegar, ¾ tsp salt and the zest of the lemon.
Nestle the chicken among the potatoes with the chorizo sliced into coins. Roast 20–25 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the chorizo edges crisp.
Scatter on ½ cup halved Kalamata olives, squeeze the lemon over everything and spoon the paprika-red pan juices on top before serving.

meals.name: Tex-Mex beef taco rice bowls with smashed avocado and cheddar
steps: Cook 1½ cups rice; stir in the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt when done. Warm the drained black beans with ½ tsp cumin and a splash of water.

Brown 1½ lb ground beef with 1 diced onion over medium-high until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F; drain most of the fat. Add 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp salt and 2 Tbsp tomato paste; cook 1 minute, then add ⅔ cup water and simmer 5 minutes until saucy.
Smash 2 avocados with the juice of ½ lime and a pinch of salt.
Build bowls: lime rice, beans, taco beef, 1 cup shredded cheddar, smashed avocado, salsa and cilantro.

meals.name: Sticky honey-sriracha salmon bowls with sesame broccoli
steps: Cook 1½ cups rice. Whisk 3 Tbsp honey, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, 1–2 Tbsp sriracha, 2 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp rice vinegar.

Cut 1½ lb salmon into 4 portions, season lightly with salt and sear skin-side up in 1 Tbsp oil over medium-high for 4 minutes. Flip, pour in the sauce and cook 3–4 minutes, spooning it over, until glossy and the fish reaches 145°F.
Meanwhile toss 1 lb broccoli florets with 1 Tbsp sesame oil and a pinch of salt; roast at 425°F for 15 minutes or steam 4 minutes, then finish with a splash of soy.
Serve salmon over rice with the broccoli, drizzle with pan sauce and top with sliced green onions.

meals.name: Creamy roasted red pepper and goat cheese pasta with garlic-chili crumbs (meatless)
steps: Roast 3 halved bell peppers and 1 head garlic (top sliced off, drizzled with oil) at 425°F for 25–30 minutes until the peppers char. Cover the peppers 10 minutes, then peel.
Toast ½ cup breadcrumbs in 1 Tbsp olive oil with 1 minced garlic clove and ¼ tsp red pepper flakes until golden, about 3 minutes.

Boil 1 lb pasta in well-salted water; save 1 cup pasta water. Blend the peppers, squeezed roasted garlic, 4 oz goat cheese, 2 Tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp lemon juice, ½ tsp salt and ½ cup pasta water until smooth.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and ½ cup grated Parmesan, loosening with more pasta water. Top with the crunchy chili crumbs and more Parmesan.

meals.name: Crispy sweet chili-garlic wings with chili-lime butter corn
steps: Pat 3 lb wings (split into flats and drumettes) very dry and toss with 1 Tbsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Bake on a rack over a foil-lined pan at 425°F for 45–50 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp and 165°F.
Simmer the sauce: ⅓ cup honey, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, 2 Tbsp sriracha, 1 Tbsp rice vinegar, 3 minced garlic cloves, ½ tsp red pepper flakes and 1 Tbsp butter for 3 minutes until slightly thick.
Cook the mini corn as directed. Mash 3 Tbsp butter with the zest of the lime, ½ tsp chili powder and a pinch of salt; brush over the hot corn and squeeze on lime juice.
Toss the wings in the sauce right before serving with the corn.

meals.name: Crispy Parmesan-garlic chicken cutlets with apple-cabbage slaw
steps: Make the slaw: thinly slice ½ head cabbage and 2 apples. Whisk 3 Tbsp mayo, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar, 1 Tbsp honey, 1 tsp Dijon, ½ tsp salt and pepper; toss and chill.

Slice 2 lb chicken breasts in half horizontally into thin cutlets and season with salt and pepper. Set up 3 dishes: ½ cup flour; 2 beaten eggs with 1 tsp Dijon; 1 cup breadcrumbs mixed with ½ cup grated Parmesan, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp Italian seasoning.
Dredge the cutlets in flour, egg, then the Parmesan crumbs. Fry in ¼ inch oil over medium-high, 3–4 minutes per side, until deep golden and 165°F. Drain on a rack and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Serve hot cutlets with lemon or a drizzle of honey-mustard and a big pile of the tangy slaw.
